limitations: Synthetic authored map and stationary 11-actor roster; not a whole-room or production capacity qualification.
Loot and authored crates are kept away from actor spawn points; crates are inert and are not damage or blast-cover witnesses.
Each metric times only its named synchronous operation; serialization covers JSON.stringify({state, view}) and byte sizing is outside the timed interval.
Finite-sample p99 is descriptive, not a tail-latency guarantee. Memory includes JS and WASM wrappers and runtime noise.

additionalCases: 53 loot + 64 authored inert crates; total dynamic capacity 128 including actors
workload.awakeMethod: Outside each timed step, queue alternating +/-2 world-unit x impulses to every loot body and +/-20 (sparse) or +/-40 (clustered) to each crate; crate signs alternate by tick and body index; actors receive none.
